prompt_inputs.goal: Carbohydrate loading for marathon competition tomorrow with high caloric intake (3500+ calories) to maximize glycogen stores

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 1 day of meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
Total daily calories meet or exceed 3500 calories for a 70kg endurance athlete
Carbohydrates comprise 60-70% of total calories to support glycogen loading
Plan is presented in compact, concise format suitable for quick reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading before competition day

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle recovery and strength gains post-training

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with pre- and post-workout nutrition timing
Macronutrient ratios support strength training (approximately 40% protein, 40% carbohydrates, 20% fats)
Total daily calories and macros are appropriate for an 85 kg strength athlete
Meals are concise and practical to prepare within one day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with specific macronutrient ratios and timing around training sessions for muscle recovery

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight while maximizing energy for training; prepare for competition weigh-in

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 3 meals fitting within 2,200-2,400 calories for the day
Includes balanced macronutrients (45-50% carbs, 25-30% protein, 20-25% fat) suitable for weight-managed athlete
All meals respect vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
Plan is presented in compact format covering breakfast, lunch, and dinner only
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
